tasks.title: Cover unsafe source paths in operator task contracts
tasks.description: Create only tests/self_development/test_contract_path_boundaries.py. Read agent/services/self_development/contracts.py and tests/self_development/test_contracts.py. Add pytest parametrized tests asserting source_path rejects absolute paths, parent traversal, dot segments, backslash paths, glob patterns, secret paths, fixture paths and directory-only roots. Include two allowed regular source paths. Do not modify implementation or existing tests. Use actual expected ValueError behavior and run the registered self-development test profile.

tasks.title: Cover symlink and oversized workspace publication rejection
tasks.description: Create only tests/self_development/test_snapshot_boundaries.py. Read agent/services/self_development/workspace.py and tests/self_development/test_workspace.py. Add focused tests proving read_source rejects a symlink file, seal_changes rejects a symlink directory, read_source rejects a file larger than 1000000 bytes, and an undeclared newly created file blocks sealing. Use tmp_path for all files and pytest.raises for actual expected ValueError behavior. Do not modify implementation or existing tests. Run the registered self-development test profile.
